exports.name: MARKDOWN_DEPTH_LIMIT
exports.doc: Deepest accepted nesting of block and inline structure.

exports.name: MARKDOWN_LINE_LENGTH_LIMIT
exports.doc: Longest accepted single line, in UTF-16 code units.

exports.name: MARKDOWN_LINE_LIMIT
exports.doc: Most lines accepted in a source. A trailing newline starts a final blank line.

exports.name: MARKDOWN_SOURCE_LIMIT
exports.doc: Longest accepted source, in UTF-16 code units.

members.name: source
members.doc: The Markdown to render. Raw HTML is dropped, and a source over one of the exported limits is replaced by invalidFallback.

members.name: baseUrl
members.doc: The absolute HTTP(S) URL, with no username or password, that relative links and images resolve against. Without it, relative links and images are not allowed.

members.name: invalidFallback
members.doc: What replaces the whole content when baseUrl is invalid or the source fails a limit.
